name: Duobaan chuanda (多巴胺穿搭)
blurb: Chinese for "dopamine dressing": bright clashing colors, a summer 2023 craze
title: 多巴胺穿搭 Meaning: China's "Dopamine Dressing" Trend
description: 多巴胺穿搭 (duobaan chuanda) means "dopamine dressing": bright, highly saturated colors worn together to lift your mood. It was China's big summer 2023 fashion trend.
h1: What does 多巴胺穿搭 (dopamine dressing) mean?
answer: 多巴胺穿搭 (duōbā'àn chuāndā, "dopamine dressing") is a style of dressing in bright, highly saturated colors, often clashing, to make yourself and others feel happier: colorful, sunny and full of energy. The name refers to dopamine, the brain chemical linked to pleasure, and the idea comes from fashion psychologist Dawnn Karen's concept of dopamine dressing. It exploded on Douyin, Xiaohongshu and Weibo in summer 2023, and in December 2023 it was named one of China's top ten internet expressions of the year.

body: The heart of the style is color: lemon yellow, orange, hot pink, grass green and sky blue worn boldly together, often with playful patterns such as checks, polka dots or cartoon prints. The official definition stresses finding harmony and balance within bright colors, so the aim is cheerful, not chaotic.
Before it took off, Chinese social media favored black, white, grey and muted "Morandi" tones. When summer 2023 arrived, the idea that brighter clothes could brighten your mood caught on fast.

head: Date

rows: Fashion creators share bright summer outfits on short-video apps with tags like 多巴胺女孩穿搭 (dopamine girl outfits)
The trend explodes on Douyin, Xiaohongshu and Weibo; the Xiaohongshu tag passes 220 million views
Coffee and tea chains launch "dopamine" drinks, and 多巴胺 becomes a marketing buzzword
China's National Language Resources Monitoring and Research Center lists 多巴胺穿搭 among its top ten internet expressions of 2023

ul: Posting an outfit: "今天来一套多巴胺穿搭。" (Going full dopamine dressing today.)
Complimenting: "你这身好多巴胺。" (Your outfit is so dopamine; it cheers me up.)
As a template: 多巴胺美食 (dopamine food), 多巴胺装修 (dopamine interiors)
Joking: "An office worker's dopamine dressing: one colorful lanyard."

faq.q: Why is it called dopamine dressing?
faq.a: Dopamine is a brain chemical associated with pleasure. The name suggests that wearing bright colors can boost your mood. The concept comes from fashion psychologist Dawnn Karen.

faq.q: How do you do dopamine dressing without looking messy?
faq.a: Pick two or three bright colors and balance them with white or tones from the same family, or wear one bright color head to toe and add a contrasting bag, shoes or accessories.

faq.q: Did 多巴胺穿搭 make a word-of-the-year list?
faq.a: Yes. On 12 December 2023, China's National Language Resources Monitoring and Research Center ranked it No. 8 among the top ten internet expressions of 2023.
